turns.question: Which kind of customer call left people happiest in September 2026, and in what share of those calls?
turns.answer: Calls about the product left people happiest in September 2026 (1-30 Sep): 75% of the 16 labelled product calls ended in a positive mood (positive-sentiment share, model-derived labels from gemini-3.5-flash, prompt v1); the other topics (delivery 1 call, pricing 4, returns 11) returned no share, so none ranks above it. Late: call_transcripts.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
